channel.title: AI News Radar
channel.description: A curated 24-hour radar of AI news: official releases, new models and high-signal discussion.

item.title: He Xi 2077 AI Deep Signal Weekly 2026 W45: Execution Foundation, Acceptance Debt, and the Boundaries of Memory
item.description: Covering November 2–8, 2026, the weekly digest distills 194 AI news items into agent execution foundations, acceptance debt, and memory boundaries, citing HEELO’s 46 tasks and Terminal-Bench’s roughly 30% benchmark problems as lingering verification work. (Daily Digest)

item.title: ChatGPT Images 2.6 — Create, edit, and animate images with AI
item.description: Despite its title promising ChatGPT Images 2.6 image creation, editing and animation features, the page serves only a CAPTCHA human-verification prompt with no readable content at all. (Product Hunt)

item.title: Claude Code's "Don't Ask Again" leaked passwords in 1,122 public GitHub files
item.description: Claude Code’s “Don't Ask Again” option let passwords and other sensitive information surface in 1,122 public GitHub files, highlighting credential-leak risks developers must watch for when using coding agents. (apiiro.com)

item.title: Microsoft Research disbands its AI Frontiers team
item.description: Microsoft Research’s roughly 50-person AI Frontiers team, founded in 2023 and behind Autogen and Fara, was folded into Microsoft AI in September 2024 and then disbanded over a clash with ex-Inflection leadership prioritizing scaling over research. (hunch.net)

item.title: Microsoft Researcher John Langford Exits. AI Frontiers Group Declared Finished
item.description: John Langford has left Microsoft and declared the roughly 50-person AI Frontiers finished after the group moved into Microsoft AI in September, saying agent research is hard to deploy under a scaling-heavy focus.

item.title: MaxxBench – "DeepSWE scores well. But is it real?
item.description: MaxxBench changed 89 DeepSWE tasks with a median reference-patch increase of just 17 lines (3.5%), and Claude Opus 5.5 scored 76.4% versus Gemini 3.8 Flash's 53.4%—a 23-point gap—as models talked themselves out of following changed requirements. (maxxbench.unlap.ai)

item.title: Show HN: We compressed a 31B video+audio diffusion model to 14B, 6 steps, INT8
item.description: Video Rebirth compressed MiniMax-H3 into 13.7B HyperFlow H3 Flash, generating video and synchronized stereo audio in 4–8 steps with INT8/GGUF builds, including GGUF on 64GB-RAM PCs and INT8 on 24GB+ RTX GPUs with 69GiB system memory.

item.title: Goodbye Claude, Hello Pi
item.description: A longtime Claude Code user switches to Pi after late AGENTS.md support and VSCode's single-session IDE restriction, noting 244 releases this year, over three-quarters touching the system prompt, and that cutting 80% of it still costs more than Pi.
